author: Torta
summary: Replying to complaints that PvP rewards/cross-faction/world bosses were missing, Torta says the notes are explicitly "to be continued".
quote: What's so difficult to understand about the patch notes being "to be continued"?

author: Torta
summary: Announces that the first post now includes the new race and class combinations (Tauren Priest, Dwarf Warlock).
quote: The post has been updated with new information on the new race and class combinations coming with the upcoming patch!

author: Torta
topic: PvP notes withheld until finalized; Thorn Gorge notes added
summary: PvP information will only be published once finalized to avoid speculation; the changelog now includes Thorn Gorge.
quote: We know everyone's waiting for the PvP updates, but we'll share them only once everything's finalized so we don't present unfinished information and fuel unnecessary speculations.

author: Torta
summary: Windhorn Canyon trailer added; dungeon level range confirmed as 26-30.
quote: Included Windhorn Canyon trailer, a new dungeon for levels 26–30!

author: Torta
topic: Survival overhaul and general changelog added
summary: First post extended with the Survival overhaul notes and the general changelog of miscellaneous changes.
quote: Added patch notes covering the Survival overhaul, along with a general changelog of miscellaneous changes throughout the game.

author: Torta
topic: Honor system rework not in changelog; PvP scope
summary: The new PvP reward progression required large itemization changes and a way to obtain the rewards was not implemented; it was left out of the changelog because readiness for release was uncertain. Confirms Thorn Gorge, world PvP events, arena-consume restrictions and PvP dampening are in the patch.
quote: It isn't in the changelog because we don't know whether we'll have it ready in time for the release.

author: Torta
summary: Denies that Redwall Keep (Redridge Mountains) was designed for Level One Lunatics.
quote: No, it wasn't designed for lunatics.

author: Torta
summary: Explains the rested XP change: taverns are more immersive than tents and capital-gate tent camps were a mess; taverns worldwide now earn rested XP at about the old tent pace; offline tavern gain unaffected; tents act like taverns but never give the full bonus.
quote: The speed of earning rested XP in a tavern is about the same as it was under a tent before 1.18.1.

author: Torta
topic: Why the rested kill-XP bonus was halved
summary: Tents were considered overpowered but too popular to remove outright; the team kept the rested bonus accessible worldwide but reduced its value so XP is not permanently doubled.
quote: nerf rested bonus actual value so XP rate isn't permanently doubled in the game.

author: Torta
summary: First post extended with the UI changes (unified options, Group Frame, keybindings search, etc.).
quote: Listed some of the UI improvements coming with this patch.

author: Torta
summary: Posts two teaser images of the new Group Frame in reply to a request.
quote: Could you possibly give us a teaser for this one? [reply: two attached images]

author: Jamey
topic: PvP rework intent (opening post of "PvP in 1.18.1")
summary: Honor gains cut to 10% with matching costs is described as a purely visual normalization; all PvP changes were "set to go live shortly after the release".
quote: As some Players were gaining hundreds of thousands of Honor a week the above change is simply to keep numbers in line and purely a visual change.

author: Torta
summary: The small launcher patch for cross-faction BGs fixes a Faction.dbc bug; the same fix is included in the Nightmares of Ursol update.
quote: The fix will also be included in the larger Nightmares of Ursol update, but because this patch is tiny and lightweight we expect players to obtain it via the launcher.

author: Hyundef
summary: A new full client download normally follows a few days after a patch to iron out issues first.
quote: New full client download is usually available a few days after the patch drops, to allow for "ironing out the kinks" prior to.

author: Torta
summary: Confirms 2026-03-20 as release day and announces a hotfix maintenance the next morning.
quote: Thanks everyone for your patience during the release day :) There'll be a quick maintenance tomorrow morning to apply hotfixes for the bugs you've reported during the day!

author: Torta
summary: The launcher updates the client continuously; the mandatory on-login patcher update was held back until more fixes were ready.
quote: The launcher is updating the game continuously at the moment. However, for the on-login patcher, we'll wait for a few more things to be fixed first before we make a mandatory update.

author: Torta
topic: Final old-system RP flush (opening post of March 25 hotfixes)
summary: Explains that half the old honor-system flush RP is still granted for one last week as compensation for the mid-week switch; RP decay already follows the new system.
quote: Players will still get half the old honor system flush RP from standings for this week as compensation for the mid-week patch release to the new System. This is the last and final week.

author: Torta
summary: Hatcher health reduced because the encounter could be too tight a DPS check.
quote: Significantly reduced health of Onyxian Hatcher (Hatchers can sometimes be too tight of a DPS check).

author: Jamey
topic: Relic swapping GCD moved into Class Changes
summary: Swapping Librams/Totems/Idols in combat was an exploited quirk; because of its impact it was handled in the class-changes cycle rather than a weekly hotfix.
quote: This was an ongoing quirk that was being (ab)used. Normally we would fix these in our weekly changelogs but because of the gravity of this change we've moved this to a Class Changes cycle.

author: Jamey
summary: Class-dependent dampening gives more design freedom to make all specs viable without player-target exceptions on many spells.
quote: Turning these values class-dependent means that we will be less restricted in Design space of making all specs come to life and be viable without adding Player-target exceptions on a lot of spells.

author: Jamey
summary: Ranged Hunter fell behind in DPS and gameplay after Class Changes 2; the kit and talent trees were reviewed to make more abilities impactful; Trueshot Aura and Steady Shot became baseline; Volley became a cast; Beast Mastery was redesigned again because the previous rework "did not hit the mark".
quote: Ranged Hunter is extremely timing-dependent and offers little reactivity in its rotation.

author: Jamey
summary: Maul and Savage Bite threat modifiers reduced because bears crowded out other tanks.
quote: Feral Bears have been overly prominent in their threat output, leaving little room for other tanks to shine.

author: Jamey
summary: Protection Paladins were strong early and scaled poorly; the Holy Strike rework trades early power for late-game scaling.
quote: These changes slightly reduce early power while significantly improving late-game scaling.

author: Jamey
summary: Daybreak combined with the Tier 3.5 bonus was far too strong; values and scaling reduced while keeping the identity.
quote: the raw power of Daybreak—especially when combined with the Tier 3.5 set bonus—was significantly too high.

author: Jamey
summary: Base healing of mid-level ranks raised as a middle ground after an earlier reduction; Lightwell became a passive healing amplifier because manual use kept it unused; Proclaim Champion replaced by the self-buff capstone Ascendance.
quote: Lightwell has stayed largely unused even after the additions of an earlier rank, a new talent and becoming a baseline spell due to it requiring manual use to utilize and often forcing players out of position.

author: Jamey
summary: Rogue judged "a bit overperformant"; poison scaling at low ranks, Taste for Blood, Noxious Assault and Opportunity trimmed without changing how the class plays.
quote: we're making a few targeted numerical adjustments aimed at bringing performance back in line without changing how the class fundamentally plays.

author: Jamey
summary: Rockbiter changed from passive damage reduction to an attack-built absorb so non-Enhancement specs stop using it as passive PvP durability.
quote: deterring non-Enhancement specializations from using the effect as a passive benefit which led to them being more durable, especially in Player vs Player environments.

author: Jamey
summary: Eye of the Storm retired for Call of Earth (Earth Shield charges and pushback resistance); Earthquake buffed to be a capstone "worthy not just in form, but in function".
quote: Proper spell pushback resistance has long been missing from Elemental, as Eye of the Storm saw little use in either PvP or PvE

author: Jamey
summary: Curse costs raised to match impact; healing reduction moved from the warlock to enslaved/greater demons; Soul Link reduced because dampening favoured survivability classes.
quote: because the recently introduced PvP dampening has been more beneficial for classes focusing on survivability, we're balancing out demonology warlock's durability.

author: Jamey
summary: Shield Slam and Defiance buffed as targeted fixes; a comprehensive Protection review planned later.
quote: Protection Warriors have been falling behind other tanks. These changes provide targeted improvements, while a more comprehensive review of the Protection talent tree and overall kit is planned for the future.

author: Jamey
topic: Shaman T1 set / Chain Heal interaction
summary: Replying to a complaint that the Shaman T1 set was nerfed instead of fixing a Chain Heal bug report, Jamey states the interaction is intended.
quote: That interaction is intended. As was said by a green name.

author: Dragunovi
topic: Fortune and Avoidance stats restricted by slot
summary: Fortune amplifies all chance-based item effects so it is limited to necklaces, cloaks and trinkets; Avoidance could nullify AoE if stacked so it is limited to cloaks and rings.
quote: Due to its compounding power with multiple chance based items, the Fortune stat can only be found on Necklaces, Cloaks and Trinkets.

author: Dragunovi
summary: Bosses can drop upgrade items that raise specific crafted items to raid power level; requires the relevant profession specialization; Blackwing Lair only at first.
quote: This will initially be added to only to Blackwing Lair with it expanding to later tiers depending on how it is received.

author: Dragunovi
summary: Fang of Venoxis, Azuresong Mageblade, Lok'amir il Romathis, Sharpened Silithid Femur and Wraith Blade got DPS increases for hybrid tanks using weapon damage plus spellpower for threat.
quote: The few changes above are aimed at hybrid tanks using both weapon damage and spellpower for their threat generation

author: Dragunovi
summary: Discipline was reworked into a Smite damage/support spec and lacked Holy-damage gear; Discipline tier sets and a Shadow Tier 2.5 set in AQ40 fill the gap.
quote: we're remedying this by adding tier sets tailored around Discipline's stat requirements and set bonuses that directly interact with its playstyle.
